EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), raylib: src/rcore.c through src/rtext.c. These 129 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 0 FP, 129 TP.

TP shapes: currentEventList, a static set only by the exported SetAutomationEventList (which stores any value) and read by RecordAutomationEvent without a test (consistent with the TP at rcore.c:4324); exported-function parameters; LoadImageColors and similar returns that are unchecked RL_MALLOC results. SHAPE CALL FOR REVIEW: par_shapes_create_disk, tinyobj_parse_obj and LoadBoneInfoGLTF return unchecked allocations; a write through them inside the callee, or a count set after such writes, is an earlier dereference rather than a check, so these rows are TP medium and name conflicts with the FP labels at rmodels.c:2902, 4448 and 6681.

23 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
